lines.notes: J2: Wideband sensor harness AEM 30-3427 (to a Bosch LSU 4.9). JST PUD side-entry header S08B-PUDSS-1. AEM pin: 1 trim (RT, green), 2 heater - (white), 3 common (VM, orange), 5 pump (IP, red), 6 sense (UN, black), 8 heater + (brown); 4 and 7 empty

R28: TPS conversion only (manual cars): protected 5 V to 1N for a 0-5 V sensor on the stock plug. Never with the stock throttle switch: it shorts 1N to ground at idle; R30: TPS conversion only (manual cars): 2L to the TPS input, in place of R29. Never on an automatic: its sensor is on 2M

R20: 12 V pull-up for the vehicle speed input. Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162: 48 mW at 15 V with the switch closed) only if your car's signal switches to ground or is open collector; a switch that drives 12 V must not have it; R21: 12 V pull-up for the A/C switch input. Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162: 48 mW at 15 V with the switch closed) only if your car's signal switches to ground or is open collector; a switch that drives 12 V must not have it; R22: 12 V pull-up for the clutch switch input. Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162: 48 mW at 15 V with the switch closed) only if your car's signal switches to ground or is open collector; a switch that drives 12 V must not have it; R27: 5 V pull-up for the stock throttle switch contact on 2L (manual cars, R29 fitted). Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162; 1.1 mA with the switch closed) to read the stock switch; never with a sensor on 2L

lines.value: Box header, 2x10, 2.54 mm, vertical (add-on header; takes a 20-way ribbon cable plug)
lines.notes: J5: Add-on I/O: COP 3/4, boost, alternator, main relay, knock, VR crank/cam, external AFR, flex-fuel sensor, nitrous arming switch, CAN for gauges, 5 V, +12 V (fused, F4)

JP4: Fit on 1994-95: the pressure regulator control solenoid on 2R. Leave open on 1989-93. Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand; JP5: Leave OPEN with the stock igniter: it drives the tachometer and sends its signal to the ECU on 2I. Fit only after a coil-on-plug conversion with the igniter removed: the ECU then drives the tachometer through 2I (R37 is its 12 V pull-up; join the two tach wires at the old igniter plug). Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand
R37: Tachometer pull-up to 12 V for the coil-on-plug case (JP5 fitted): the stock tachometer needs it once the igniter is gone. 2512, 1 W (0.2 W at 14.4 V)

D3: NOT FITTED with a rev 0.10 daughterboard, which clamps the injectors itself. With a rev 0.9 daughterboard on a 1989-93 car: fit (SMCJ30A, SMC, LCSC C224048), clamp for the two injectors on 2U; D4: NOT FITTED with a rev 0.10 daughterboard, which clamps the injectors itself. With a rev 0.9 daughterboard on a 1989-93 car: fit (SMCJ30A, SMC, LCSC C224048), clamp for the two injectors on 2V

lines.value: Throttle position sensor, Kia, 3-pin Mazda-style plug
lines.notes: Also sold as 0K24718911, 0K30A18911 or aftermarket TH291 / 5S5504 / TPS4185 (rusEFI wiki list). Plugs into the car's stock throttle switch plug: 1N gives it 5 V (fit R28), 2D is its ground, 2L its signal (move R29 to R30). Before fitting R28, check with an ohmmeter which sensor pins are the track ends (constant resistance between them at any throttle) and that they meet the 1N and 2D wires; the third pin, the wiper, must meet 2L. If the reading falls as the throttle opens, TunerStudio's calibration handles it
